question: Calculate the difference of the total amount spent in all events by the Student_Club in year 2019 and 2020.
statements:
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "event_budget_spend" AS SELECT e.event_id, e.event_date, COALESCE(SUM(CAST(b.spent AS DOUBLE)), 0.0) AS spent FROM table_1 e LEFT JOIN table_2 b ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id GROUP BY e.event_id, e.event_date

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH eb AS (
    SELECT 
        CAST(SUBSTR(event_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) AS year,
        COALESCE(spent, 0.0) AS spent
    FROM event_budget_spend
    WHERE event_date IS NOT NULL
),
sum_by_year AS (
    SELECT year, SUM(spent) AS total_spent
    FROM eb
    WHERE year IN (2019, 2020)
    GROUP BY year
),
pivot AS (
    SELECT
        COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2019 THEN total_spent END), 0) AS total_2019,
        COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2020 THEN total_spent END), 0) AS total_2020
    FROM sum_by_year
)
SELECT
    total_2019,
    total_2020,
    total_2019 - total_2020 AS difference_2019_minus_2020
FROM pivot;
